system.description: The specialty gives a person extra knowledge about the undead, spirits, mist creatures, demons, and similar entities. The person knows their ideologies, governance, lifestyle, fears, strengths, weaknesses, and more. The person can add +2 to their Skill Value per level when trying to learn about these types of creatures.
system.summary: Illuminates undead, spirits, mist creatures and demons: their nature, fears and weaknesses.
